prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Explore companion breeds and choose who lives on your screen.", "Select Companion Breed"]
1: ["Signing in secures your pet collection across devices and prevents pet resets.", "Cloud Pet Sync Enabled"]
2: ["Your Companion is Ready for Desktop!", "Look for your companion wandering near your taskbar. Double click to interact anytime.", "Summon Pet to Desktop"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home...", "We are setting up your companion's animations and favorite spots.", "Initializing Pet AI...", "Tip: You can move your pet anywhere on your desktop by dragging it."]
4: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick a quick ready-to-play pet or craft a custom companion from your photos.", "Instant Pet Adoption", "Custom Pet Creator"]
5: []

7: ["Bonus Unlocked: Starter Snack Pack Included!"]
8: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your new companion a name to make it officially yours!", "Name Your Pet", "Official Companion Badge"]
9: ["Welcome Home to Your Desktop Companion!", "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.", "Start Playing Now"]
